name: qwen_ppo_v2

config.reference: same frozen base with adapters disabled
config.sampling: full categorical policy: temperature=1 top_p=1 top_k=0, no forced minimum length
config.reward: actual trained Chinese preference BERT checkpoint; no newly invented human labels
config.loss: clipped token policy + clipped value; terminal learned reward - beta * sampled token KL
config.algorithm: GAE gamma=1 lambda=.95; whiten advantages over rollout tokens
